## Summary

Describe the problem, the chosen approach, and the user-visible result.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security or privacy hardening
- [ ] Build, dependency, or operations change

## Trust boundaries

Describe any effect on authorization, policy, tool selection, signed evidence,
financial calculations, citations, model access, delivery scoring, audit,
storage, telemetry, Studio isolation, or the read-only order boundary. Write
`None` when no boundary changes.

## Verification

List the exact commands and focused scenarios you ran.

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run security:scan`
- [ ] `npm run license:verify`
- [ ] `npm run docs:verify`
- [ ] `npm run open-source:verify`
- [ ] Relevant Azerbaijani and English behavior is covered
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` was run for browser-visible changes
- [ ] Failure behavior was tested for changed external dependencies

## Visual evidence

Add screenshots or recordings for user-interface changes. Use only public,
approved, or synthetic data and remove identifiers, credentials, prompts, raw
model output, and private traces.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated rewrites.
- [ ] Tests fail without the fix or otherwise demonstrate the new behavior.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration examples are updated when needed.
- [ ] No credential, customer data, account data, private document, or runtime
      database is included.
- [ ] Substantive financial output remains tool/evidence based rather than a
      ready-written answer catalog.
- [ ] The assistant remains unable to submit, modify, or cancel an order.
- [ ] I have read and followed `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under Apache-2.0.

## Migration and release notes

Describe required configuration, persisted-data, API, or deployment changes.
Write `None` when not applicable.
